from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from hashlib import sha256
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_UP
import json
class Visible(HTMLParser):
 hidden=0
 items=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  if tag in ('script','style'): self.hidden+=1
 def handle_endtag(self,tag):
  if tag in ('script','style'): self.hidden=max(0,self.hidden-1)
 def handle_data(self,s):
  if not self.hidden: self.items.append(' '.join(s.split()))
root=Path('products/distribution/invoice-referral-fit')
raw=(root/'raw/zoho.html').read_bytes()
digest=sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest=='060113c16960955f5d235f4b2b145b702f9b407f4348afdbeb67155031472885'
p=Visible()
p.feed(raw.decode())
terms=[next(s for s in p.items if q in s) for q in ('earn 15% of the revenue','equals or exceeds $100','different data center','Affiliate payouts are decided')]
